purpose: Make genuine research easy to complete. The full protocol remains available and unchanged; this profile keeps only the checks that actually prevent fabrication and records the rest as visible, non-blocking observations.

G1: program/topic-decision.md is non-empty and written by the owner
program/topic-shortlist.json lists at least three real candidates
program/core-thesis.json declares one overarching doctoral question

non_blocking: search-result screening sheets and per-row human screening records
hypothesis audit staleness and optional quality assessments
missing optional validators (e.g. jsonschema) and independent-review observations
numeric scores, venue quartiles, impact factors and journal AI-policy observations
still_hard: G1/G2 topic approvals require a named human --actor (researchctl approve)
no automatic submission, no fabricated citations/results/reviews
source hashes, cumulative budget, failed-attempt ledger and role separation
G2-G5 keep the full protocol until explicitly enabled here
model_overrides: config/model-routing.local.json (git-ignored, owner supplied real model IDs)
note: This profile lowers ceremony, not integrity. It never fills in scientific content, never marks unverified work as verified, and never approves a gate without a human actor.
